facts.fact: Youm7 reports that a Public Prosecution course held on 8-12 November 2026 teaches the provisions of Egypt's Law 175 of 2018 on information technology crimes, including search and seizure warrants.

EGY.note: A training course is not use of the law.

facts.fact: Youm7 reports that the Personal Data Protection Centre, led by an acting chief executive, Suzan El-Okbawy, sent 22 members to a Public Prosecution training course on 8-12 November 2026.
Youm7 reports that the Public Prosecution's course covers the rules and offences of Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law 151 of 2020 and its executive regulations.
Youm7 names the executive regulations of Law 151 of 2020 among the texts taught in the Public Prosecution course of 8-12 November 2026.
Youm7 reports that the Personal Data Protection Centre, with an acting chief executive, has 22 staff trained as judicial officers in the 8-12 November 2026 course.
Youm7 reports a five-day Public Prosecution training course for 22 Personal Data Protection Centre staff on enforcing Law 151 of 2020, with no decision reported.
Youm7 lists Egypt's Electronic Signature Law 15 of 2004 among the laws related to the data protection law in the Public Prosecution course of November 2026.
